changelog.text:
**v0.1.5** · 25 changes from 5 contributors

## Highlights
Turn a No project thread into a project. Use Claude and GPT models and thinking controls with Antigravity. Customize thread details, including usage limits. Switch all your installations between Stable and Nightly in one step.

## Fixes
- New threads avoid providers that just hit usage limits (#26234)
- Guest links no longer expose file diffs (#26538)
- Claude edits open as diffs, not raw JSON (#26529)
- Fixed a desktop security vulnerability in Brotli decompression (#26348)
- Undo notices no longer cover threads (#26874)
- Antigravity file reads no longer show unrelated errors (#26910)
- T3 starts on fresh Ubuntu servers without libatomic (#26912)
- Update everything no longer unnecessarily waits for npm (#26917)
- Antigravity file reads no longer keep spinning (#26928)
- Copilot follow-ups no longer kill background agents (#26715)
